source.attribution: Source: Agencia Estatal Boletín Oficial del Estado (BORME), datos abiertos.

access.note: Two-step crawl: summary endpoint then per-province bulletin XML. Be polite (no documented rate limit).

pagination.note: Iterate by publication date (YYYYMMDD). 404 on non-publication days. For each date, fetch section-A item url_xml bulletins.

snapshot.note: Persist the daily summary JSON and each province bulletin XML before parsing prose into acts.

parsing.notes:
Acts are Spanish prose in

/

. Use a BORME parser (e.g. bormeparser) to extract acto types + 'Datos registrales' (T/F/S/H/IA). Hoja registral is the dedup key (CIF usually absent). Capital uses es number locale. Officer/sole-shareholder names are PII.

mapping_rules.legal_name: Company name from p.articulo (strip leading act number).
mapping_rules.registration_number: hoja_registral (province letters + number) from Datos registrales.

fixture_requirements: Ampliación de capital act (Capital + Resultante Suscrito)
act with multi-line Datos registrales / unusual punctuation

live_test_plan.smoke: GET sumario/20240115 (JSON); assert section A items; fetch one url_xml; parse at least one articulo+parrafo and extract the Hoja.
live_test_plan.full: Iterate dates from 2009-01-01 behind an env gate; for each, fetch all section-A bulletins; parse acts; dedup into a company master keyed on Hoja registral; throttle politely.

blockers: Act text is unstructured Spanish prose — robust parsing (bormeparser) required.
CIF usually absent from act text — join to financials needs name/Hoja matching.
Officer/sole-shareholder personal data — GDPR handling required.
